about: Single source of truth for every SAE J1979 item Vibecode my car knows: services, PIDs, byte lengths (with variants), formulas, units, ranges and field breakdowns. Decoders and labels are generated from this file.

provenance.validated: formula and width taken from the OBDCraft (former name) benchmark dataset (standard_pids.json), cross-checked against several independent public implementations and re-decoded against 5,673 real readings with 0 mismatches
provenance.secondary: authored from public OBD-II PID tables (Wikipedia 'OBD-II PIDs' and similar); SAE J1979 itself was not read; treat as likely but unconfirmed
provenance.observed: confirmed on a real vehicle capture

formula_language: Bytes are A, B, C ... (first data byte after the PID is A). Operators: + - * / % << >> & | ^ ~, comparisons, ?:, functions s8() s16() s32() min() max() abs() bit(x,n).

services.name: Clear fault codes and stored values
services.warning: Erases stored and pending codes, freeze frames, self-check results (mode 06) and readiness. The car then needs a full drive cycle before its self-checks are complete again (relevant for emission tests such as PUC).

services.name: Oxygen sensor monitoring test results (non-CAN only)
Pending emission fault codes (current or last drive cycle)
Control of on-board system, test or component
services.warning: Vibecode my car only asks which tests exist (0800); it never runs a test.

readiness.source: secondary: public OBD-II PID tables; the standard text was not read

pids.name: Monitor status since codes cleared
pids.notes: byte A: MIL and count; B: continuous monitors; C: engine-type-specific monitors available, D: those not complete (spark or compression set chosen by B3; bit 4 changed meaning between revisions). Service applicability: one secondary table states that PID 01 is not available in service 02; python-OBD and AndrOBD mirror every PID into service 02 mechanically. Both modes are kept because the vehicle's own service 02 support bitmap decides

pids.name: Fault code that stored the freeze frame

fields.name: Fault code that stored the freeze frame

pids.notes: service applicability is split: one secondary table states that PID 02 exists only in service 02, while python-OBD defines it as a service 01 command; both modes are kept and the vehicle's support bitmaps decide. In service 02, 00 00 means that no freeze frame is stored (the same table), so the other service 02 values are then meaningless; the decoder still renders it as P0000
